newsitem.title: INDIA: Morgan Stanley sees Bombay index at 4,600 in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley sees Bombay index at 4,600 in 1997.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Asia Ltd expects the Bombay Stock Exchange's sensitive index to rise to at least 4,600 points in 1997, a senior executive said on Friday.
"We see the index at 4,600 in the year," Morgan Stanley Asia chairman John Wadsworth told Reuters on the margins of a business conference in the Indian capital.
The Bombay bourse's sensitive index closed at 3,876.04 points on Thursday. The exchange was closed on Friday for a bank holiday.
Asked if Morgan Stanley planned to add fresh funds to the Indian market, Wadsworth said: "We have no plans now."
